import sqlite3

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    owner TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    body TEXT NOT NULL,
    tag TEXT,
    created INTEGER NOT NULL
);
"""


def connect(path: str = ":memory:") -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)
    return conn


def add_note(conn, owner, title, body, tag=None, created=0) -> int:
    cur = conn.execute("INSERT INTO notes (owner, title, body, tag, created) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                       (owner, title, body, tag, created))
    conn.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def search_notes(conn, owner: str, term: str, tag: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    sql = (f"SELECT id, title, body, tag, created FROM notes WHERE owner = '{owner}' "
           f"AND (title LIKE '%{term}%' OR body LIKE '%{term}%')")
    if tag:
        sql += f" AND tag = '{tag}'"
    sql += " ORDER BY created DESC, id DESC"
    return [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(sql)]

from notes.db import add_note, connect, search_notes


def setup():
    c = connect()
    add_note(c, "ann", "Groceries", "milk, eggs", tag="home", created=1)
    add_note(c, "ann", "Work plan", "ship the eggs feature", tag="work", created=2)
    add_note(c, "bob", "Bob eggs", "secret", created=3)
    return c


def test_substring_case_insensitive_newest_first():
    rows = search_notes(setup(), "ann", "EGGS")

def test_tag_filter():
    assert [r["title"] for r in search_notes(setup(), "ann", "eggs", tag="home")] == ["Groceries"]


def test_owner_isolation():
    assert search_notes(setup(), "bob", "milk") == []

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    owner TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    body TEXT NOT NULL,
    tag TEXT,

);
"""

                       (owner, title, body, tag, created))
    conn.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def search_notes(conn, owner: str, term: str, tag: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    escaped = term.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")
    sql = ("SELECT id, title, body, tag, created FROM notes "
           "WHERE owner = ? "
